subject: Post-call recap & request to schedule leadership bridge
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Simmons <elliot.simmons@edgefin.com>, Nina Park <nina.park@edgefin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & request to schedule leadership bridge

Hi Elliot / Nina —

Thanks again for the call today — helpful to hear where EdgeFin is prioritizing inference reliability and cost predictability for the new risk-scoring pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary needs: predictable per-transaction latency (P95), lower per-token unit cost at 10M+/month, and documented data residency controls for EU customers.
- Current blockers: leadership alignment for pilot budget and one-page acceptance criteria for procurement.

Proposed next steps
1) Short leadership bridge (VP / CTO + Head of Product) to align scope and pilot gating criteria — 30 minutes.
2) Follow-up technical deep dive (SRE/infra + SE-led demo) to validate perf and integration details — 60 minutes.

Suggested windows (PT):
- Thu Oct 14 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Fri Oct 15 — 09:00–11:30 (we have flexibility for a 30 or 60 minute leadership window)

Connor and Marissa are cc'd to coordinate the technical agenda and collateral. Attaching the post-call notes and a draft mutual action plan to speed approvals. If you can confirm which time works for the leadership bridge (and whether Tom Reyes, your CTO, can join), I will lock the invite and share a one-slide architecture and ballpark economics in advance.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: postcall-notes.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: Elliot Simmons <elliot.simmons@edgefin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@edgefin.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & request to schedule leadership bridge

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise summary. Tom (our CTO) is available on Fri Oct 15 around 10:00am PT for a short leadership touch — 30 minutes would be ideal for our execs. They want the meeting to focus on:

- High-level success criteria for the pilot (what does “good” look like)
- Preliminary cost range for a dedicated/reserved approach at ~10M tokens/month
- Any data residency or compliance hard constraints up front

We can follow the technical deep dive afterwards (we'll bring our infra lead). Confirming Oct 15, 10:00–10:30 PT unless you suggest otherwise.

Appreciate you looping Connor in — can he prepare a one-slide architecture summary we can review beforehand?

Best,
Elliot
Director, Product — EdgeFin

Date: 2027-10-13T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & request to schedule leadership bridge — proposed agenda

Elliot / Nina —

Happy to take the one-slide architecture ask. For the leadership bridge I suggest we keep it tightly scoped:

Leadership bridge (30m) — proposed flow
- 0–5m: Introductions & business context (Karthik / Elliot)
- 5–15m: High-level platform fit + projected outcomes (Marissa)
- 15–25m: Key controls & compliance summary (Connor) — data residency, audit logs, KMS/HSM options
- 25–30m: Next steps / decisions needed to unblock pilot (all)

Separate technical deep dive (60m) where we can demo the serving runtime, KV caching behavior, and expected P95 throughput under your sequences. I attached a short leadership brief and a technical runbook that maps to the pilot gates.

Would you prefer the one-slide be an architecture diagram or a short bulleted summary of controls and SLAs? I can produce both and drop the architecture PNG into the invite.

Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: leadership-brief.pdf, tech-runbook.md
